fresh.name: Suitcase Deadlift
fresh.cue: Shoulders stay level — don't let the bell tip you.
fresh.standard: Full lockout with the torso square, no side-bend, bell touches the floor each rep.

fresh.name: Double Kettlebell RDL
fresh.cue: Feel the hamstrings stretch, then snap the hips.
fresh.standard: Bells lowered to mid-shin without the lower back rounding, full hip lockout at the top.

fresh.name: Two-Hand Swing
fresh.cue: Hike it back like a football snap, then snap the hips — the arms are ropes.
fresh.standard: Bell floats to chest height, knees and hips locked, glutes and abs braced at the top.

fresh.name: One-Hand Swing
fresh.cue: Free arm mirrors the working arm; shoulders stay square.
fresh.standard: As the two-hand swing, plus no torso rotation and the shoulder stays packed.

fresh.name: Hand-to-Hand Swing
fresh.cue: Switch at the float — don't grab, receive.
fresh.standard: Clean handoff at the top with no loss of arc.

fresh.name: Double Swing
fresh.cue: Wider stance, bells stay outside the knees.
fresh.standard: Both bells reach chest height together, full hip lockout.

fresh.name: Dead-Stop Swing
fresh.cue: Reset the tension every rep — no stretch reflex to help you.
fresh.standard: Bell comes to full rest on the floor between reps, then a fresh hike.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Clean
fresh.cue: Tame the arc — thread your hand through the handle, don't let it flip.
fresh.standard: Bell arrives in the rack silently against the forearm, no banging, hips and knees locked.

fresh.name: Double Clean
fresh.cue: Bells travel between the legs, land soft in the rack.
fresh.standard: Both bells land in the rack simultaneously, standing tall.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Snatch
fresh.muscles_secondary: front-delt, traps, grip, forearm, abs, lat
fresh.cue: One motion floor to overhead — punch up through the bell at the top.
fresh.standard: Bell finishes locked overhead, elbow straight, biceps by the ear, no press-out, no banging.

fresh.name: Single-Rack Front Squat
fresh.cue: Loaded side doesn't collapse — ribs down, obliques on.
fresh.standard: Hip crease below the knee, torso vertical and square, bell stays racked.

fresh.name: Double Front Squat
fresh.cue: Bells crush into the chest — brace like a corset.
fresh.standard: Hip crease below the knee, both bells stay racked, full lockout.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Overhead Squat
fresh.cue: Eyes on the bell, arm vertical, sit between the heels.
fresh.standard: Full squat depth with the arm locked and vertical throughout.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Cossack Squat
fresh.cue: Sit into one hip, keep the straight leg's heel down.
fresh.standard: Working hip below the knee, extended leg straight with toes up, return to standing.

fresh.name: Goblet Lateral Lunge
fresh.cue: Step wide, load the outside hip, push back off it.
fresh.standard: Working knee tracks over the foot, trailing leg straight, return to feet together.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
fresh.cue: Hold the bell forward as a counterweight and sit straight down.
fresh.standard: Full depth on one leg, free leg off the floor throughout, stand without touching down.

fresh.name: Racked Reverse Lunge
fresh.cue: Step back long, back knee kisses the floor, torso stays vertical.
fresh.standard: Rear knee touches or nearly, front hip below the knee, return to full standing.

fresh.name: Goblet Walking Lunge
fresh.cue: Long steps, tall chest — travel, don't wobble.
fresh.standard: Rear knee touches the floor each step, chest upright.

fresh.name: Overhead Reverse Lunge
fresh.cue: Arm locked and vertical the whole rep — the shoulder is the hard part.
fresh.standard: Rear knee touches with the bell locked overhead, stand to full lockout.

fresh.name: Tactical Lunge
fresh.cue: Pass the bell under the front leg at the bottom — smooth, no slap.
fresh.standard: A clean hand-to-hand pass under the front thigh at the bottom of every rep.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Military Press
fresh.cue: Press away from the ground — squeeze the glutes and lat, exhale through the sticking point.
fresh.standard: Elbow locked overhead with the biceps by the ear, no leg drive, no side bend.

fresh.name: Double Military Press
fresh.cue: Two bells, zero lean — brace the whole body.
fresh.standard: Both elbows locked overhead simultaneously, no back arch.

fresh.name: See-Saw Press
fresh.cue: One goes up as the other comes down — never both at rest.
fresh.standard: Each arm reaches full lockout; one rep per arm.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Push Press
fresh.cue: Short dip, hard drive, then finish with the arm.
fresh.standard: One dip only, bell locked overhead, no second dip under the bell.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Jerk
fresh.cue: Dip, drive, then dip under the bell and catch it locked.
fresh.standard: Double dip: bell caught with a locked elbow, then legs straighten to full standing.

fresh.name: Half-Kneeling Press
fresh.cue: Squeeze the down-side glute — it stops you leaning.
fresh.standard: Full overhead lockout from half-kneeling without torso lean or hip shift.

fresh.name: Bottoms-Up Press
fresh.cue: Crush the handle — the bell tells you the moment you lose alignment.
fresh.standard: Bell stays inverted from rack to lockout; a wobble onto the forearm is a no-rep.

fresh.name: Sots Press
fresh.cue: Press from the bottom of the squat without standing up an inch.
fresh.standard: Full overhead lockout achieved while the hip stays below the knee.

fresh.name: Double Floor Press
fresh.cue: Both triceps touch together — no rocking.
fresh.standard: Both upper arms touch the floor, both elbows lock at the top.

fresh.name: Crush-Grip Press
fresh.cue: Squeeze the bell like you're trying to pop it — that's the chest working.
fresh.standard: Bell pressed to full arm extension while both hands keep maximal squeeze.

fresh.name: Push-Up on Kettlebell Handles
fresh.cue: Deeper range than the floor — keep the bells from tipping.
fresh.standard: Chest descends below handle level, elbows lock at the top, body in one line.

fresh.name: Double Bent-Over Row
fresh.cue: Hinge to parallel and stay there — no body English.
fresh.standard: Both bells reach the hips together, torso angle unchanged.

fresh.name: Gorilla Row
fresh.cue: One bell stays planted as an anchor — resist the twist.
fresh.standard: Working bell reaches the hip, hips stay square, other bell stays on the floor.

fresh.name: Renegade Row
fresh.cue: Widen the feet and keep the hips dead level — the row is the easy part.
fresh.standard: Bell reaches the hip with no hip rotation or sag; one rep per arm.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Floor Pullover
fresh.cue: Ribs stay down — the stretch comes from the lats, not the low back.
fresh.standard: Bell travels to full overhead stretch with the lower back flat, returns over the chest.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Farmer Carry
fresh.cue: Tall and proud — shoulders packed down, don't shrug or shuffle.
fresh.standard: Continuous walking with no set-down for the prescribed time or distance.

fresh.name: Racked Carry
fresh.cue: Breathe behind the brace — the rack squeezes your ribs, that's the point.
fresh.standard: Bell stays in a clean rack with the elbow tight to the ribs throughout.

fresh.name: Waiter Walk (Overhead Carry)
fresh.cue: Bell stacked over the shoulder over the hip — one vertical line.
fresh.standard: Elbow locked and arm vertical for the whole distance.

fresh.name: Bottoms-Up Carry
fresh.cue: Death grip on the handle, elbow glued to the ribs.
fresh.standard: Bell stays inverted for the whole distance; a flip is a failed set.

fresh.name: Mixed Carry (rack + overhead)
fresh.cue: One racked, one overhead — the asymmetry is the exercise.
fresh.standard: Both positions held cleanly for the distance, then switch sides.

fresh.name: Half Get-Up
fresh.cue: Punch the bell up and roll to the elbow — that's the whole rep.
fresh.standard: Floor to elbow to hand and reverse, with the arm vertical throughout.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Arm Bar
fresh.cue: Let the top shoulder screw into the socket while you breathe.
fresh.standard: Arm stays vertical while the hips rotate to the floor; hold and breathe.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Overhead Hold
fresh.cue: Lock the elbow, pack the shoulder, ribs down.
fresh.standard: Arm stays vertical and locked for the full duration.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Windmill
fresh.cue: Push the loaded-side hip out, then reach for the floor with a straight top arm.
fresh.standard: Bottom hand reaches the floor or instep with the top arm locked vertical, then stand fully.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Bent Press
fresh.cue: You don't press the bell up — you press yourself down under it, then stand.
fresh.standard: Bell moves from rack to locked overhead by the body descending, then a full stand to lockout.

fresh.name: Around-the-Body Pass
fresh.cue: Hips and shoulders stay still — only the bell travels.
fresh.standard: One full lap around the waist with a clean hand-off front and back.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Figure-8
fresh.cue: Hinge, don't squat — the bell goes through the legs, the chest stays up.
fresh.standard: One full figure-8 through both legs with a clean handoff each side.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Clean & Press
fresh.cue: The clean is a free rest — reset the rack before every press.
fresh.standard: One clean plus one strict press to lockout, then the bell returns to the rack.

fresh.name: Long Cycle (Double Clean & Jerk)
fresh.cue: Breathe in the rack and in the lockout — that's where the set is won.
fresh.standard: Both bells cleaned to rack, then jerked to a simultaneous overhead lockout, then returned.

fresh.name: Kettlebell Thruster
fresh.cue: One continuous motion — the squat launches the press.
fresh.standard: Hip crease below the knee at the bottom, bells locked overhead at the top, no pause.
